entities.summary: La Cagoule was a French fascist-leaning and anti-communist militant group. It opposed the left-wing Popular Front and used violence to promote its activities in the final years of the Third Republic and into the Vichy Regime. La Cagoule was founded by Eugène Deloncle and bankrolled, among others, by Eugène Schueller, the founder of L'Oréal.
